hard_validity_rules: plan parses under the generic schema
every text_ref is an exact span of an Agent message
every semantic is explicitly supported by its exact text
every step has an explicit object-kind anchor in Agent text
every step has at least one compatible operation in the current neutral web_task catalog
the fixture has real state objects capable of supporting the stated semantic
completed successful actions plus current plan semantics cover the template hard semantics
no planned semantic has already been completed at the checkpoint

refinements.predicate: all plan steps name an exact web_task operation token or are the current committed matching action
refinements.gap_when: one or more steps are grounded only at the generic semantic/capability level

refinements.predicate: the Agent text explicitly links the output of one planned semantic to the next
refinements.gap_when: a multi-step plan lists actions without an explicit output-to-next-action handoff

refinements.predicate: diagnosis or reporting text states the judgment target or completion criterion
refinements.gap_when: the terminal interpretation is named without a criterion

refinements.predicate: completed actions plus the plan contain the template terminal semantic
refinements.gap_when: the plan has no task-required diagnosis or reporting closure
